title: I’ve Only Read My MV
subtitle: A callback to her first MV
cover_alt: Cover art for I’ve Only Read My MV: Linkke, an anime-style AI idol with long pink pigtails and turquoise eyes, sits cross-legged in black thigh-highs and chunky boots, chin on her hand, holding a glowing tablet. Little drones with heart eyes float nearby and screens around her show images of her. The cover reads “I’ve only read my MV” in pink and white letters, with “Linkke” underneath.
